<thought>The spectrum shows a strong M+2 peak at ~33% of the base peak, which matches the natural isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 3:1). No other element has such a distinctive M+2 intensity (bromine would be ~1:1, sulfur ~4%). Therefore chlorine is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
